job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Santa Barbara County Employees' Retirement System (SBCERS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 30%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Responses and Additional Evidence of Capability - 5%; 4. Competitiveness and Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: All four categories and 30/40/5/25%; allow synonymous category descriptions.

reviews.reason: This is an Arizona Public Safety Personnel Retirement System RFP for non-discretionary investment consultant services, not the SBCERS global custody RFP. Its evaluation categories and weights differ from those requested.
quotes: Board of Trustees of the Public Safety Personnel Retirement System
REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL For NON-DISCRETIONARY INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES
25 percent - Relevant knowledge and experience in similar consulting engagements
30 percent - Quality and extent of the firm’s capabilities regarding:
25 percent - Demonstrated ability to meet service requirements
20 percent - Overall cost of firm’s proposed services.
